b: I was feeling a little blue about the recent market decline. My spirits had been buoyed most of the year by the great results. As a dollar cost averager I typically contribute regularly except for things like Roth IRA contributions which I do at the beginning of the year. Given that that's 6 weeks away, knowing my luck the market will recover by then.
Then I remembered that I hadn't yet contributed to my kids' Trump Accounts yet. I just maxed those babies out at $5000 each. Buy buy buy!
